scope: Source-only independent safety audit; no production or root authority.

target.only_authorized_original_checkpoint: 405b (parent-specified; full exact binding to be read in sealed preparation)
target.raw_unrelated_index_records: Require freshly captured full raw records and independently check all record bytes; prior 58,552 count is context only, never evidence of current state.
target.canonical_AA: No assignment until actual live browser gates; this review never grants it.

required_mechanisms: Hash and parse each seal from the same owned bytes buffer.
Capture and publish the complete validated raw index buffer through an exclusive O_RDWR sibling descriptor; complete writes, fsync, seek, same-FD readback, lstat/fstat ownership and identity.
A distinct exclusive held index.lock sentinel spans index replacement, HEAD/ref CAS, and guarded non-force push; clean only the regular matching owned inode, reject symlink and foreign entry.

Actual separate root stage, full current code/copy, and independent audit adoption, then a separate actual approval of the pending exact commit; false templates and invented booleans are never authority.

Exact eleven public path set with native originals at article roots, full hash/type/order/null/schema preservation, unchanged unrelated files, site configuration, original inputs and raw index records.
Strict complete file and directory closure, excluding only exact root manifest/seal terminal names; no revisions or future-directory exclusion; retain failure history.

accepted: Stable own destination names and ancestors
Cooperative Git writers honor held index.lock
Trusted Git executable and effective configuration as explicitly bound/qualified
not_claimed: Isolation from a noncooperating local pathname writer
required_residual_disclosures: Last identity-check to rename and cleanup check to unlink windows
Expected-before aggregate check to replacement window
Index replacement and ref update are separate
Partial files/index/ref/remote/receipts may remain after failure; root must inspect actual state before any repetition

allowed_review_actions: Read the immutable current preparation after parent FINAL notice
Read full helpers, full inert diff, templates, requirements and receipts before execution
New pure closure only after source review
Meaningfully bounded isolated toy FD/lock/index controls only within this own folder
forbidden_review_actions: Read or touch actual website or real .git
External human communication or prepared outreach
success_criterion: Independent checkable source verdict with exact current code pins, full namespace custody, actual allowed pure closure results, and explicit remaining gaps. Parent alone decides adoption and mutation.
initial_falsification_plan: Examine authority dispatch for invented or reusable approval
Check buffer-versus-path dataflow from validation through publication
Check independent lock lifecycle and foreign-inode/symlink cleanup behavior
Check complete raw-index records and exact Git object/ref/push boundaries
Recompute complete current source/diff and exact final extent
